explanation: This asks for an upper bound for h(N) better than N^{2/3}, posed as h = O(answer) with answer = o(N^{2/3}). The colouring definition of h (every 4-AP gets ≥ 3 colours) is fine. However, erdosproblems.com #160 records Hunter's improvement h(N) ≪ N^{log 3/log 22 + o(1)} ≈ N^{0.355}, which already gives such an answer. So the `research open` tag is outdated; this formulation is solved. The statement itself is fine.
